note: Three parallel gravel sites on Robbins Road in the Whiskey Springs ATV area, which the booking pages describe as part of the Northcentral Regional ATV Trail System: WS011 and WS012 at the head of the road on the Shintown side, and WS013 about 770 m south at the middle log gate. DCNR warns visitors to stay alert for ATVs on the roads. The agency cautions that it is reached by remote dirt or gravel forest roads that may not suit low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. No table, toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: All three site pages re-read: WS011, WS012, WS013 still listed, Drive-In, Trailer Site category, max vehicle 25 ft (equipment length 35), parallel gravel, spur 50 ft; count 3 and 25 ft confirmed, pull_through false and a sites note added. Kept under ruling 1: no agency page names these sites' ground as ATV parking (see flags). Year-round confirmed; all sell in all five windows. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri and PASDA): WS011 and WS012 points inside one gravel clearing about 45 x 25 m off Robbins Road, with circular tyre marks on the leaf-off image; WS013's point at a three-way forest-road junction with no pad resolved. NHD: nothing within 200 m; not waterfront.
flags: ATV check (ruling 1), kept, for the owner's eye: the pages say 'LOCATION: Campsite is part of the Northcentral Regional ATV Trail System. Head of Robbins Road, Shintown side.' (WS011, WS012) and '... Robbins Road, Middle "Log Gate"' (WS013), plus 'Limitation: ATVs on designated roads/trails only.' None calls the ground a parking area, unlike WS007-WS009 ('at the Whiskey Springs Trailhead Parking Area'). The DCNR Whiskey Springs brochure (rev. 4/22/16) names and maps its parking areas: Boyer Road (41.36806,-77.86572), Area 36 (41.34132,-77.86864), Shintown Run (41.38189,-77.86247), Whiskey Springs (41.32859,-77.87774) and Huling Branch (41.31909,-77.85785); the nearest is over 2 km from these sites (41.34693,-77.83808 / 41.34673,-77.83764 / 41.33996,-77.83664), and the brochure does not show Robbins Road by name. The district's 2025 map labels them 'Whiskey Springs ATV Area Campsites'. Imagery shows WS011 and WS012 sharing a gravel clearing about 45 x 25 m with circular tyre marks; that is an observation, not an agency statement, so ruling 1 was not applied.
Span: WS013 is about 770 m south of WS011/WS012 (which are about 43 m apart), under 1 km; left as one entry. WS013's page has no site photos.

Pin: stored pin equals WS012's point (41.34673,-77.83764), inside the shared clearing. WS013's point (41.33996,-77.83664) falls on a three-way road junction where no pad is visible on either image set. Not moved.

Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured, no road surface, gate or bridge research): 'Caution: This campsite is accessed by remote state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not be suitable for some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs.' No grade lines, no Severe grade, no site-specific 4WD or wet-weather statement, no clearance line. Kept. Boilerplate on every page of the district, not site-specific: 'State forest roads are not maintained in the winter and often become snow covered, icy and potentially impassable' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).

ATVs: Sproul advisories page, 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads' and 'The Whiskey Springs and Bloody Skillet ATV trails have resumed normal winter/summer seasonal operations.' The calendars sell all three sites in February and mid-May 2027, when the ATV trails are closed. No page limits the sites to ATV riders.

Sproul advisories page (read 2026-11-10): nothing on this site's road. It carries a Bloody Skillet ATV section closure (April 20, 2026), the indefinite Left Branch Young Womans Creek Road closure, 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads' and a dust advisory.
